meaning.en: Having a quick mind for writing; ideas and wording come fast.
meaning.zh: 写文章时思路开阔、反应很快。

equivalents: quick to put ideas into words

examples.zh: 他文思敏捷，一个小时就写完了报告。
examples.en: He writes quickly and fluently; he finished the report in an hour.

examples.zh: 这位记者文思敏捷，截稿前总能交出好文章。
examples.en: The reporter thinks fast on paper and always files a good piece before the deadline.

usage.en: Usually a predicate describing a writer or student; praise.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容人写作时思路快，含褒义。

meaning.en: Visitors are so numerous that they come and go like threads on a loom.
meaning.zh: 游览的人很多，往来不断，像织布的梭子一样。

examples.zh: 国庆假期，景区游人如织。
examples.en: During the National Day holiday the scenic area was thronged with visitors.

examples.zh: 春天的公园里游人如织，到处是拍照的人。
examples.en: In spring the park is full of visitors, with people taking photos everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate; typical in travel writing and news about holidays and tourist spots.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于旅游报道和游记。

literal: hide away and live · mountains · forests
natural: retire to a life in the hills

meaning.en: To withdraw from society and live in the mountains and forests.
meaning.zh: 离开尘世，住在深山老林中。

equivalents: live as a hermit in the mountains

examples.zh: 他厌倦了官场，决定隐居山林。
examples.en: Tired of official life, he decided to live as a hermit in the mountains.

examples.zh: 传说那位老人曾隐居山林三十年。
examples.en: It is said the old man once lived secluded in the hills for thirty years.

usage.en: Verb phrase; bookish, often about scholars or sages of the past.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面色彩较浓，多指古代文人、高士。

meaning.en: Leaving such a deep impression that one cannot forget it.
meaning.zh: 给人留下很深的印象，让人忘不掉。

examples.zh: 那次旅行令人难忘。
examples.en: That trip was unforgettable.

examples.zh: 她在晚会上的演唱令人难忘。
examples.en: Her singing at the party was unforgettable.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (令人难忘的一天); usually pleasant, though it can be neutral.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多指美好的印象。

literal: not the slightest · without · scruple · fear

meaning.en: Acting without any concern for consequences or what others think.
meaning.zh: 做事一点也不考虑后果或别人的看法。

examples.zh: 他在会上毫无顾忌地批评了领导。
examples.en: He criticised the boss in the meeting without any inhibition.

examples.zh: 孩子们毫无顾忌地在雪地里打滚。
examples.en: The children rolled about in the snow without a care.

usage.en: Mostly an adverbial (毫无顾忌地); neutral to critical depending on context.
usage.zh: 多作状语（毫无顾忌地），可褒可贬，视语境而定。

literal: not the slightest · without · holding back

meaning.en: Giving or telling everything, keeping nothing back.
meaning.zh: 把全部都拿出来或说出来，什么也不留。

examples.zh: 老师把自己的经验毫无保留地教给了学生。
examples.en: The teacher passed on all her experience to her students without holding anything back.

examples.zh: 他毫无保留地支持这项计划。
examples.en: He supports the plan without reservation.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (毫无保留地 + verb); can also be a predicate.
usage.zh: 常作状语（毫无保留地＋动词），也可作谓语。

literal: spend · to the limit · mind · thought

meaning.en: To use up a great deal of thought and effort on something.
meaning.zh: 花了很多心思和精力去想办法。

examples.zh: 为了给妈妈一个惊喜，他费尽心思准备礼物。
examples.en: To surprise his mother, he went to great lengths over her present.

examples.zh: 公司费尽心思想留住这位设计师。
examples.en: The firm tried everything it could think of to keep the designer.

usage.en: Predicate, often followed by a verb phrase; the variant 用尽心思 is interchangeable.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后常接动词性成分；“用尽心思”可替换。

meaning.en: To make a firm decision and be determined to carry it out.
meaning.zh: 经过考虑，做出坚定的决定。

examples.zh: 他下定决心，今年一定要戒烟。
examples.en: He made up his mind to give up smoking this year.

examples.zh: 她下定决心去国外读书。
examples.en: She resolved to go abroad to study.

usage.en: Verb phrase, usually followed by a clause or verb phrase; also 下定了决心.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，后常接小句或动词短语，可说“下定了决心”。

literal: not · care about · personal feelings · face

meaning.en: To apply rules strictly and not let personal relationships affect one's judgement.
meaning.zh: 办事坚持原则，不因人情关系而迁就。

examples.zh: 检查组执法不讲情面，该罚的一律罚。
examples.en: The inspectors showed no favour and fined everyone who deserved it.

examples.zh: 他做事向来不讲情面，亲戚也不例外。
examples.en: He never lets personal ties count; relatives are no exception.

usage.en: Predicate; praise when about fairness, mild criticism when it suggests coldness.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；说执法公正时是褒义，说人冷淡时略带贬义。

meaning.en: Generous and tolerant in outlook; not petty about small matters.
meaning.zh: 气量大，能容人，不计较小事。

examples.zh: 他心胸开阔，从不为小事生气。
examples.en: He is broad-minded and never gets upset over small things.

examples.zh: 心胸开阔的人更容易交到朋友。
examples.en: Open-hearted people find it easier to make friends.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; describes character.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，形容人的气量。

meaning.en: Having a high standard of moral character.
meaning.zh: 道德品质很高。

examples.zh: 大家都敬佩他品德高尚。
examples.en: Everyone admires him for his noble character.

examples.zh: 教师应当是品德高尚的人。
examples.en: Teachers should be people of high moral standing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; fairly formal, used in tributes and commendations. 品格高尚 is the variant.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，较正式，多用于表彰、赞扬；“品格高尚”为异形。

meaning.en: Possessing outstanding skill and ability.
meaning.zh: 本事很大，能力很强。

examples.zh: 孙悟空本领高强，却也有大意的时候。
examples.en: Sun Wukong is immensely capable, yet he too has his careless moments.

examples.zh: 他想练就一身本领高强的功夫。
examples.en: He wants to train himself into a martial artist of formidable skill.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; slightly storytelling in tone.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，略带故事色彩。

literal: one · heart · for · the public good

meaning.en: Putting all one's heart into serving the public rather than oneself.
meaning.zh: 一心一意为大家的利益着想。

equivalents: wholly devoted to the public interest

examples.zh: 他一心为公，退休前从没拿过一分不该拿的钱。
examples.en: He was entirely public-spirited and never took a penny that was not his.

examples.zh: 干部要一心为公，不谋私利。
examples.en: Officials should serve the public wholeheartedly and not seek private gain.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, common in political and official language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，较正式，常见于政治和公文语体。

meaning.en: Not knowing how to adapt to changed circumstances.
meaning.zh: 不懂得根据实际情况灵活处理。

examples.zh: 他做事死板，总是不知变通。
examples.en: He is rigid at work and never adapts.

examples.zh: 规则是死的，人不能不知变通。
examples.en: Rules are fixed, but people should know when to bend.

usage.en: Predicate; mildly critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，略带批评。

meaning.en: Acting immediately, with no hesitation at all.
meaning.zh: 一点也不迟疑，立刻行动。

examples.zh: 看到有人落水，他毫不犹豫地跳了下去。
examples.en: Seeing someone fall in, he jumped in without hesitation.

examples.zh: 她毫不犹豫地接受了这份工作。
examples.en: She accepted the job without hesitating.

usage.en: Almost always adverbial (毫不犹豫地 + verb).
usage.zh: 几乎都作状语（毫不犹豫地＋动词）。

meaning.en: Having an impressive, dignified manner that stands out from the ordinary.
meaning.zh: 风度气质出众，不同一般。

examples.zh: 这位老先生气度不凡，一看就是见过大世面的人。
examples.en: The old gentleman has a distinguished air; clearly he has seen the world.

examples.zh: 新来的总经理气度不凡。
examples.en: The new general manager carries himself with great presence.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used of people. Variants: 气度非凡, 风度不凡, 气质不凡.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，形容人；另有“气度非凡”“风度不凡”“气质不凡”。

meaning.en: Facing one difficulty after another.
meaning.zh: 遇到的困难一层又一层，非常多。

examples.zh: 这个项目困难重重，但大家没有放弃。
examples.en: The project is beset with difficulties, but nobody gave up.

examples.zh: 创业之初困难重重。
examples.en: The start-up phase was full of obstacles.

usage.en: Predicate; 重重 is read chóng chóng. Also 困难重重的 + noun.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“重重”读chóng chóng，也可说“困难重重的……”。

meaning.en: To push ahead with courage and vigour.
meaning.zh: 鼓起勇气，努力往前冲。

examples.zh: 队员们奋勇向前，终于冲过了终点线。
examples.en: The team members pushed bravely on and finally crossed the finish line.

examples.zh: 面对困难，我们要奋勇向前。
examples.en: We must press ahead in the face of difficulties.

usage.en: Predicate, often in exhortations and sports or news writing.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常见于号召性语句和体育、新闻报道。

meaning.en: Free from restrictions; doing as one pleases.
meaning.zh: 不被限制，自由自在。

examples.zh: 退休后，他过着不受拘束的生活。
examples.en: After retiring he lived a life free of constraints.

examples.zh: 艺术家需要不受拘束的创作空间。
examples.en: Artists need room to create without constraint.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; variant 不受约束 is a little more formal.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语；“不受约束”稍正式。

meaning.en: Full of enthusiasm and energy for the work in hand.
meaning.zh: 做事劲头很大，热情很高。

examples.zh: 新来的同事干劲十足，大家都受到了感染。
examples.en: The new colleague is full of drive and has infected everyone.

examples.zh: 春耕时节，农民们干劲十足。
examples.en: At spring ploughing time the farmers are working with great energy.

usage.en: Predicate; fairly colloquial. Often 干劲十足地 + verb.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语色彩较浓，也可说“干劲十足地＋动词”。

meaning.en: Not known to others; hidden or unrecognised.
meaning.zh: 没有被别人知道。

examples.zh: 这位科学家有不为人知的一面。
examples.en: The scientist had a side to him that few people knew.

examples.zh: 他的付出一直不为人知。
examples.en: His contribution went unnoticed all along.

usage.en: Usually attributive (不为人知的故事) or predicate; 为 is read wéi.
usage.zh: 多作定语（不为人知的故事）或谓语；“为”读wéi。

meaning.en: A great many different styles, types or tricks.
meaning.zh: 样式、种类或名堂很多。

examples.zh: 夜市里的小吃花样繁多。
examples.en: The night market offers snacks in endless variety.

examples.zh: 现在的手机游戏花样繁多，孩子很容易沉迷。
examples.en: Mobile games now come in so many forms that children easily get hooked.

usage.en: Predicate; can also hint at too many fancy tricks.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，有时略含“名堂太多”的意思。

meaning.en: To stand by what one has said and do it.
meaning.zh: 说出的话要做到，不反悔。

equivalents: be as good as one's word

examples.zh: 你放心，我说话算数。
examples.en: Don't worry, I keep my word.

examples.zh: 爸爸说话算数，周末真的带我们去了动物园。
examples.en: Dad keeps his promises; he really took us to the zoo at the weekend.

usage.en: Colloquial predicate; 数 is read shù. Often used to reassure or to test someone's promise.
usage.zh: 口语中作谓语，“数”读shù，常用来保证或质问。

meaning.en: All the different trades and professions.
meaning.zh: 各种各样的行业。

examples.zh: 来参加招聘会的有各行各业的人。
examples.en: People from every line of work came to the job fair.

examples.zh: 各行各业都出现了人才短缺。
examples.en: Every industry is short of talent.

usage.en: Attributive (各行各业的人) or subject; 行 is read háng.
usage.zh: 多作定语（各行各业的人）或主语；“行”读háng。

meaning.en: Proud and overestimating oneself, looking down on others.
meaning.zh: 自以为了不起，看不起别人。

examples.zh: 他取得一点成绩就骄傲自大，结果很快被超过了。
examples.en: He grew conceited after a small success and was soon overtaken.

examples.zh: 骄傲自大的人很难听进别人的意见。
examples.en: Arrogant people rarely listen to others.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; clearly critical.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，贬义明显。

meaning.en: Touching people to the very depths of their feelings.
meaning.zh: 非常感动人，触动很深。

examples.zh: 这部电影讲述的亲情故事感人至深。
examples.en: The film's story of family love is deeply moving.

examples.zh: 他的演讲感人至深，台下许多人落泪。
examples.en: His speech was so moving that many in the audience wept.

usage.en: Predicate or post-noun modifier (故事感人至深); common in reviews and news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于影评、报道。

meaning.en: To let things develop naturally without forcing them.
meaning.zh: 不去强求，让事情自然发展。

examples.zh: 感情的事不能强求，顺其自然吧。
examples.en: You cannot force feelings; just let things take their course.

examples.zh: 考试之前别太紧张，顺其自然就好。
examples.en: Don't be too nervous before the exam; just go with the flow.

usage.en: Verb phrase, often as advice: 顺其自然吧. Can sound fatalistic.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常用于劝慰（顺其自然吧），有时略显消极。

literal: true · false · hard to · tell apart
natural: hard to tell real from fake

meaning.en: So mixed that one cannot tell what is true and what is false.
meaning.zh: 真的假的混在一起，很难分辨。

equivalents: impossible to tell true from false
hard to separate fact from fiction

examples.zh: 网上消息真假难辨，转发前要核实。
examples.en: Online news is hard to verify, so check before you share.

examples.zh: 这幅画仿得真假难辨。
examples.en: The painting is copied so well that no one can tell it from the original.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; 难辨 is read nán biàn.
usage.zh: 作谓语或补语，“难辨”读nán biàn。

meaning.en: Working together so smoothly that little needs to be said.
meaning.zh: 合作时彼此心领神会，非常协调。

examples.zh: 两位前锋配合默契，进了一个漂亮的球。
examples.en: The two forwards were perfectly in sync and scored a beautiful goal.

examples.zh: 他们俩合作多年，配合默契。
examples.en: The two have worked together for years and understand each other well.

usage.en: Predicate; common in sports and teamwork contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于体育和团队合作的语境。

meaning.en: To study very hard, putting up with hardship.
meaning.zh: 吃苦耐劳，用功读书。

examples.zh: 为了考上理想的大学，他每天刻苦攻读到深夜。
examples.en: To get into his dream university he studied hard every night until late.

examples.zh: 她刻苦攻读，终于拿到了博士学位。
examples.en: She studied tirelessly and finally earned her doctorate.

usage.en: Predicate, often adverbial before a verb (刻苦攻读多年).
usage.zh: 作谓语，也可作状语（刻苦攻读多年）。

meaning.en: So charming that everyone who sees them likes them.
meaning.zh: 谁见了都喜欢。

examples.zh: 这个小姑娘乖巧可爱，人见人爱。
examples.en: The little girl is so sweet that everyone adores her.

examples.zh: 他脾气好又幽默，真是人见人爱。
examples.en: He is good-tempered and funny; everybody loves him.

usage.en: Colloquial; usually a predicate, often with 花见花开 in the playful set 人见人爱，花见花开.
usage.zh: 口语，多作谓语，常与“花见花开”连用。

literal: not the slightest · without · complaint · words

meaning.en: Putting up with hardship or extra work without a word of complaint.
meaning.zh: 一句抱怨的话也没有。

examples.zh: 他加班到半夜，却毫无怨言。
examples.en: He worked until midnight without a word of complaint.

examples.zh: 母亲为这个家操劳了一辈子，毫无怨言。
examples.en: Mother toiled for the family all her life and never complained.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; usually admiring.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或状语，常含赞许。

meaning.en: Not wanting to refuse or criticise because of personal ties or one's own face.
meaning.zh: 因为顾及面子或人情，不好意思拒绝或直说。

equivalents: out of consideration for someone's feelings

examples.zh: 他碍于情面，不好意思拒绝朋友的请求。
examples.en: Out of loyalty to his friend, he could not bring himself to say no.

examples.zh: 碍于情面，她没有当众指出同事的错误。
examples.en: Out of courtesy, she did not point out her colleague's mistake in public.

usage.en: Usually the start of a clause explaining why someone acted a certain way; 碍 is read ài.
usage.zh: 常放在句首，说明某种做法的原因；“碍”读ài。

meaning.en: Being so seriously ill or injured that death may be near.
meaning.zh: 病情或伤势很重，快要死了。

examples.zh: 伤者生命垂危，已被送往医院抢救。
examples.en: The injured man, in critical condition, was rushed to hospital.

examples.zh: 得知爷爷生命垂危，全家立刻赶回老家。
examples.en: Hearing Grandad was critically ill, the whole family rushed home.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (生命垂危的病人); common in news.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（生命垂危的病人），常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: Giving one's time and effort to others or to a cause with no thought of reward.
meaning.zh: 不为自己打算，把力量和心血献给别人或事业。

equivalents: give oneself without thought of return

examples.zh: 护士们无私奉献，守护着病人的健康。
examples.en: The nurses give themselves selflessly to look after their patients' health.

examples.zh: 他一生无私奉献，深受大家尊敬。
examples.en: He gave selflessly all his life and is deeply respected.

usage.en: Verb phrase or attributive (无私奉献的精神); common in commendation and news.
usage.zh: 可作谓语，也可作定语（无私奉献的精神），常见于表彰和新闻。

meaning.en: Equipped with a full set of weapons and gear.
meaning.zh: 配备了全套武器和装备。

examples.zh: 全副武装的警察包围了现场。
examples.en: Fully armed police surrounded the scene.

examples.zh: 登山队员全副武装，准备向顶峰冲刺。
examples.en: Fully kitted out, the climbers prepared for the final push to the summit.

usage.en: Often attributive (全副武装的士兵); can be used humorously for any full gear. 副 is a measure word.
usage.zh: 常作定语（全副武装的士兵），也可幽默地指装备齐全。

literal: not the slightest · without · shame · look

meaning.en: Showing no sign of embarrassment about something one ought to be ashamed of.
meaning.zh: 一点也没有惭愧的表情。

examples.zh: 做错了事，他却毫无愧色。
examples.en: He had done wrong yet showed not a trace of shame.

examples.zh: 她被揭穿谎言后仍毫无愧色。
examples.en: Even after her lie was exposed she looked completely unashamed.

usage.en: Predicate; usually critical, but may also mean 'with a clear conscience'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，通常含贬义，有时也指问心无愧。

meaning.en: To cry out loud without holding back.
meaning.zh: 毫无顾忌地大声哭。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她放声大哭。
examples.en: Hearing the news, she burst into loud sobs.

examples.zh: 孩子摔倒后放声大哭。
examples.en: The child fell over and wailed loudly.

usage.en: Predicate or verb phrase; stronger than 哭泣.
usage.zh: 作谓语，比“哭泣”更强烈。

meaning.en: Fitting common sense and ordinary human feeling.
meaning.zh: 符合常情和道理。

examples.zh: 他的要求合乎情理，公司同意了。
examples.en: His request was reasonable and the company agreed.

examples.zh: 这样解释合乎情理。
examples.en: That explanation makes sense.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 合乎 is somewhat formal.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，“合乎”稍正式。

meaning.en: The ups and downs and changes of life and society over time.
meaning.zh: 社会和人间的事情不断变化。

examples.zh: 世事变迁，当年的小渔村已成了大都市。
examples.en: Times have changed; the little fishing village is now a big city.

examples.zh: 经历了世事变迁，老人显得格外平静。
examples.en: Having lived through great changes, the old man seemed especially calm.

usage.en: Often at the start of a sentence as a reflective remark; slightly bookish.
usage.zh: 常放在句首作感慨，略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: To misappropriate public funds and accept bribes.
meaning.zh: 非法占有公款，收受贿赂。

examples.zh: 这名官员因贪污受贿被判刑。
examples.en: The official was sentenced for embezzlement and bribe-taking.

examples.zh: 他贪污受贿的数额巨大。
examples.en: The sums he embezzled and took in bribes were huge.

usage.en: Verb phrase or noun phrase; legal and news register.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或名词性成分，用于法律和新闻语体。

meaning.en: Each one differing from the others.
meaning.zh: 每个都不一样。

examples.zh: 每个人的性格各不相同。
examples.en: Everyone's personality is different.

examples.zh: 这几家店的价格各不相同。
examples.en: The prices at these shops all differ.

usage.en: Predicate; 相 is read xiāng.
usage.zh: 作谓语，“相”读xiāng。

meaning.en: Having great aspirations but no chance to realise them.
meaning.zh: 有远大的志向，却不能实现。

examples.zh: 他一生壮志难酬，晚年只能以诗自遣。
examples.en: His ambitions were never fulfilled, and in old age he consoled himself with poetry.

examples.zh: 这位将军壮志难酬，令人叹息。
examples.en: The general never saw his ambitions fulfilled, a sad thing.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 抱负难展 in elegiac writing. 酬 here means to fulfil.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，带感叹色彩；“酬”在此指实现。

meaning.en: So evenly matched that it is hard to say which is better.
meaning.zh: 双方水平接近，分不出谁强谁弱。

examples.zh: 两位选手实力接近，难分高下。
examples.en: The two players are so close in strength that it is hard to separate them.

examples.zh: 这两部小说各有千秋，难分高下。
examples.en: Each of the two novels has its strengths; it is hard to pick a winner.

usage.en: Predicate; common in sport and competition reports.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于体育和比赛报道。

literal: a hundred · ways · pick on · find fault

meaning.en: To find fault in every possible way.
meaning.zh: 用各种办法找毛病。

examples.zh: 婆婆对新媳妇百般挑剔。
examples.en: The mother-in-law found fault with the new bride at every turn.

examples.zh: 客户对设计方案百般挑剔，改了十几遍。
examples.en: The client nitpicked the design endlessly and made us revise it a dozen times.

usage.en: Usually 对 + person/thing + 百般挑剔; critical.
usage.zh: 常用“对＋人/事＋百般挑剔”，含贬义。

meaning.en: Gathered together in such number or scale that it makes a grand spectacle.
meaning.zh: 汇聚在一起，规模盛大，景象壮丽。

examples.zh: 上万只候鸟同时起飞，蔚为壮观。
examples.en: Tens of thousands of migratory birds took off together, a magnificent sight.

examples.zh: 节日的灯海蔚为壮观。
examples.en: The sea of festival lanterns was a spectacular sight.

usage.en: Usually a predicate that closes a description. 蔚 is read wèi; compare 蔚为大观.
usage.zh: 常放在描写之后作谓语；“蔚”读wèi，参见“蔚为大观”。

meaning.en: A moment of great danger when everything is at stake.
meaning.zh: 情况非常危险、紧急的时刻。

examples.zh: 危急关头，他第一个冲了上去。
examples.en: At the critical moment, he was the first to rush forward.

examples.zh: 越是在危急关头，越要保持冷静。
examples.en: The more critical the moment, the calmer one must stay.

usage.en: Usually a time phrase at the start of a sentence (危急关头，……) or after 在/到.
usage.zh: 多放在句首作时间状语（危急关头，……），或接在“在/到”之后。
